collaboration.title: Human-human-robot cooperation
collaboration.alt: Two people and iCub around a tabletop shape-sorting task with an occluder and response buttons.
collaboration.caption: Two participants and iCub in a cooperation experiment testing how robot social cues affect human-human coordination.
collaboration.credit: Experimental photograph provided by Di Fu; Fu et al., IEEE RO-MAN, 2023.

zh.title: 人与人-机器人合作
zh.alt: 两人和 iCub 围坐在桌边进行图形分类任务，桌上设有遮挡板和响应按钮。
zh.caption: 两名参与者与 iCub 开展协作实验，检验机器人社会线索如何影响人与人的协调。
zh.credit: 实验照片由 Di Fu 提供；Fu 等，IEEE RO-MAN，2023。
zh.sourceLabel: HIT 研究报告，第 12 页幻灯片

humanAttention.title: Human audiovisual attention experiment
humanAttention.alt: A participant wearing headphones faces three screen-based avatars during an audiovisual attention experiment.
humanAttention.caption: An audiovisual task tests how gaze and sound location jointly orient human attention.
humanAttention.credit: Research video cover provided by Di Fu; Fu et al., International Journal of Social Robotics, 2023.

zh.title: 人类视听注意实验
zh.alt: 一名戴着耳机的参与者面向屏幕上的三个虚拟形象，参加一项视听注意实验。
zh.caption: 视听实验检验注视与声音位置如何共同引导人类注意。
zh.credit: 研究视频封面由 Di Fu 提供；Fu 等，《International Journal of Social Robotics》，2023。
zh.sourceLabel: IIT 主题演讲，第 7 页和第 21 页

icubAttention.title: Crossmodal social attention on iCub
icubAttention.alt: Silent original footage of the iCub robot head with headphones watching three masked avatars on a monitor and moving its eyes in an audiovisual attention experiment.
icubAttention.caption: Original experiment footage: running our trained audiovisual saliency model, iCub views the same masked-avatar scene as human participants and orients towards gaze and sound cues.
icubAttention.sourceLabel: IIT keynote, slide 9 video; Fu et al., IJSR 2023

zh.title: iCub 上的跨模态社会注意
zh.alt: 无声原始录像：戴着耳机的 iCub 机器人头部注视显示器上三个戴口罩的虚拟人，并在视听注意实验中转动眼球。
zh.caption: 原始实验录像：iCub 搭载我们训练的视听显著性模型，观看与人类被试相同的戴口罩虚拟人场景，并依据注视与声音线索调整视线。

crossmodalModel.title: Computational modelling of audiovisual attention
crossmodalModel.alt: Computational modelling slide showing social-cue representations, directed attention, sequential integration and binaural audiovisual sound localisation.
crossmodalModel.caption: Human behavioural results inform the crossmodal attention model and its iCub implementation.
crossmodalModel.credit: Full-slide rendering from Di Fu's IIT keynote, slide 8; Fu et al., International Journal of Social Robotics, 2023.

zh.title: 视听注意的计算建模
zh.alt: 计算建模幻灯片，展示社会线索表征、定向注意、序贯整合，以及双耳视听声音定位。
zh.caption: 人类行为结果启发跨模态注意模型及其在 iCub 上的实现。
zh.credit: Di Fu 在 IIT 主旨演讲第 8 页幻灯片的完整呈现；Fu 等，《International Journal of Social Robotics》，2023。
zh.sourceLabel: IIT 主题演讲，第 8 页

hriFree.title: HRI-Free: physical and simulated evaluation
hriFree.alt: HRI-Free figure: panels A-C show iCub sensing, social-cue and gaze-history inputs, priority-map predictions, and physical and simulated views.
hriFree.caption: HRI-Free evaluates attention models using prerecorded stimuli and human gaze data with physical iCub sensing. This is early-stage evaluation, not live human interaction.
hriFree.credit: Fig. 3 from Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA, 2025.
hriFree.sourceLabel: Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA 2025, Fig. 3

zh.title: HRI-Free：物理与模拟评估
zh.alt: HRI-Free 图示：A-C 面板展示 iCub 的感知输入、社会线索与注视历史输入、优先级图预测，以及实体与模拟视图。
zh.caption: HRI-Free 使用预录刺激、人类注视数据及实体 iCub 感知评估注意模型。这是早期评估，并非实时人机交互。
zh.credit: 图 3 引自 Abawi 和 Fu，IEEE ICRA，2025。

hriEvaluation.title: Embodied social-attention evaluation
hriEvaluation.alt: Physical iCub facing prerecorded multi-person video, beside panels showing a priority map, simulation projection and head-eye movements.
hriEvaluation.caption: Social-attention predictions connect to simulated views and physical iCub head and eye movements as the robot observes prerecorded social video.
hriEvaluation.credit: Research image from Di Fu's University of Surrey profile; HRI-Free, IEEE ICRA, 2025.

zh.title: 具身社会注意评估
zh.alt: 实体iCub面向多人预录视频，旁侧面板展示优先级图、仿真投影及头眼运动。
zh.caption: 社会注意预测与模拟视角及实体 iCub 的头部和眼动相对应；机器人观察的是预录社会视频。
zh.credit: 研究图片来源：Di Fu 的萨里大学个人主页；HRI-Free，IEEE ICRA，2025。
zh.sourceLabel: 萨里大学官方个人简介，2025年5月21日

hriPipeline.title: HRI-Free scanpath control pipeline
hriPipeline.alt: Pipeline diagram: sampled video frames and audio chunks feed social cue detection; fixation history, output buffers and sequential integration predict a priority map whose peak is converted into coordinates for the robot gaze controller.
hriPipeline.caption: The gaze model pipeline: social cues detected in sampled video and audio are integrated over time with fixation history to predict a priority map, whose peak drives the robot's gaze in real time.
hriPipeline.credit: Fig. 2 from Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA, 2025.
hriPipeline.sourceLabel: Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA 2025, Fig. 2

zh.title: HRI-Free 扫视路径控制流程
zh.alt: 流程图：采样的视频帧与音频片段输入社会线索检测；注视历史、输出缓冲与时序整合共同预测优先级图，其峰值经坐标转换后送入机器人注视控制器。
zh.caption: 注视模型流程：从采样视频与音频中检测社会线索，结合注视历史进行时序整合以预测优先级图，其峰值实时驱动机器人的注视。
zh.credit: 图 2 引自 Abawi 和 Fu，IEEE ICRA，2025。

neuroUnfairness.title: Neural responses to unfairness to self and others
neuroUnfairness.alt: Fig. 9 schematic of brain regions in unfairness processing: SMA and dorsal anterior insula are common to self and others, with dACC and ventral anterior insula stronger for self; self-evaluation recruits dACC/SMA, right DLPFC and anterior insula, self-response left anterior insula and putamen; others-evaluation recruits left IPL-TPJ and others-response left DLPFC.
neuroUnfairness.caption: An fMRI meta-analysis of social decision-making: unfairness to self and to others both engage the anterior insula and dACC/SMA, more strongly for self. Unfairness to others recruits theory-of-mind regions (IPL-TPJ) during evaluation and cognitive control (left DLPFC) during response.
neuroUnfairness.credit: Fig. 9 from Li, Lai et al. (incl. Fu), NeuroImage, 2024; CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

zh.title: 自身与他人遭受不公时的神经反应
zh.alt: 论文图 9 不公平加工脑区示意图：辅助运动区和背侧前脑岛为自身与他人共同激活，背侧前扣带回和腹侧前脑岛在自身不公时更强；自身评价募集背侧前扣带回/辅助运动区、右侧背外侧前额叶和前脑岛，自身反应募集左侧前脑岛和壳核；他人评价募集左侧顶下小叶-颞顶联合区，他人反应募集左侧背外侧前额叶。
zh.caption: 社会决策的 fMRI 元分析：自身与他人遭受不公均激活前脑岛和背侧前扣带回/辅助运动区，且自身不公时更强。他人遭受不公在评价阶段募集心理理论相关脑区（顶下小叶-颞顶联合区），在反应阶段募集认知控制相关脑区（左侧背外侧前额叶）。
zh.credit: 图 9 引自 Li、Lai 等（含 Fu），NeuroImage，2024；CC BY-NC-ND 4.0。
